includedTopics.label: Complex Locus and Geometric Transformation
includedTopics.description: Given a complex number z satisfying |z-a| = k|z-b|, find the locus and then determine the maximum area of a triangle formed by z and two fixed points on the locus under a rotation transformation.

includedTopics.label: Parametric System of Equations
includedTopics.description: A system of three linear equations in three variables contains two parameters; determine the values of these parameters for which the system has infinitely many solutions, then find the specific solution that minimizes a quadratic form.

includedTopics.label: Conditional Probability in Recursive Games
includedTopics.description: Two players play a game involving drawing balls from multiple urns with changing compositions; calculate the conditional probability of a specific outcome given the game terminates at a specific step.

includedTopics.label: Tangent Properties and Locus of Orthocenter
includedTopics.description: Find the locus of the orthocenter of a triangle formed by three points on a hyperbola, where two of the points are fixed and the third is variable such that the tangent at that point satisfies a specific slope condition.

includedTopics.label: Function Defined by Integral
includedTopics.description: Given a function f(x) defined as an integral with variable limits, find the extrema of f(x) by applying the Leibniz rule and solving the resulting transcendental equation.

includedTopics.label: Skew Lines and Volume Optimization
includedTopics.description: Find the shortest distance between two skew lines defined by vector equations, then use this distance as the height of a parallelepiped to find the volume given a constraint on the base vectors.

blueprints.label: Complex Locus and Geometric Transformation

blueprint.pattern: Given a complex number z satisfying |z-a| = k|z-b|, find the locus and then determine the maximum area of a triangle formed by z and two fixed points on the locus under a rotation transformation.
blueprint.required: Must involve conversion to Cartesian coordinates and optimization of area using the geometric properties of the resulting circle.
blueprint.banned: Simple identification of the locus without the subsequent optimization step.
blueprint.stemHint: If |z-1| = 2|z+i|, find the maximum area of the triangle formed by z, the origin, and the point 1+i.

blueprints.topic: Competitive › Engineering › JEE Advanced › Mathematics · Hard non-single (multi/integer/match) HIGH topics: Complex Numbers, Logarithms, Permutations and Combinations, Matrices and Determinants, Probability, Conic Sections (Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola), Three-Dimensional Geometry, Applications of Derivatives, Integral Calculus, Differential Equations, Vectors
blueprints.label: Parametric System of Equations

blueprint.pattern: A system of three linear equations in three variables contains two parameters; determine the values of these parameters for which the system has infinitely many solutions, then find the specific solution that minimizes a quadratic form.
blueprint.required: Must use rank-nullity or determinant properties to find parameter constraints, followed by a constrained optimization.
blueprint.banned: Direct Cramer's rule application for a unique solution.
blueprint.stemHint: For the system x+y+z=2, x+2y+3z=5, x+3y+λz=μ, find λ and μ such that the system is consistent and x^2+y^2+z^2 is minimized.

blueprints.topic: Competitive › Engineering › JEE Advanced › Mathematics · Hard non-single (multi/integer/match) HIGH topics: Complex Numbers, Logarithms, Permutations and Combinations, Matrices and Determinants, Probability, Conic Sections (Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola), Three-Dimensional Geometry, Applications of Derivatives, Integral Calculus, Differential Equations, Vectors
blueprints.label: Conditional Probability in Recursive Games

blueprint.pattern: Two players play a game involving drawing balls from multiple urns with changing compositions; calculate the conditional probability of a specific outcome given the game terminates at a specific step.
blueprint.required: Must use total probability theorem combined with a recursive relation for the state space.
blueprint.banned: Simple urn problems with fixed probabilities and no termination condition.
blueprint.stemHint: Urn A has 2 red, 3 white; Urn B has 3 red, 2 white. A coin is tossed to pick an urn. If a white ball is drawn, it is replaced by a red ball. Find the probability the third draw is white given the first two were red.

blueprints.concept: Tangent Properties and Locus of Orthocenter
blueprints.label: Tangent Properties and Locus of Orthocenter

blueprint.pattern: Find the locus of the orthocenter of a triangle formed by three points on a hyperbola, where two of the points are fixed and the third is variable such that the tangent at that point satisfies a specific slope condition.
blueprint.required: Must link the parametric coordinates of the hyperbola with the geometric definition of the orthocenter.
blueprint.banned: Standard tangent-at-a-point calculation without the locus requirement.
blueprint.stemHint: Let P, Q be fixed points on xy=c^2. If R is a variable point on the hyperbola such that the tangent at R is parallel to PQ, find the locus of the orthocenter of triangle PQR.

blueprints.topic: Competitive › Engineering › JEE Advanced › Mathematics · Hard non-single (multi/integer/match) HIGH topics: Complex Numbers, Logarithms, Permutations and Combinations, Matrices and Determinants, Probability, Conic Sections (Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola), Three-Dimensional Geometry, Applications of Derivatives, Integral Calculus, Differential Equations, Vectors
blueprints.label: Function Defined by Integral

blueprint.pattern: Given a function f(x) defined as an integral with variable limits, find the extrema of f(x) by applying the Leibniz rule and solving the resulting transcendental equation.
blueprint.required: Must involve a non-trivial substitution to simplify the integrand before differentiation.
blueprint.banned: Direct integration of polynomials or simple trigonometric functions.
blueprint.stemHint: Let f(x) = integral from x to x^2 of (ln(t)/(1+t)) dt. Find the value of x in (1, infinity) where f'(x) = 0.

blueprints.topic: Competitive › Engineering › JEE Advanced › Mathematics · Hard non-single (multi/integer/match) HIGH topics: Complex Numbers, Logarithms, Permutations and Combinations, Matrices and Determinants, Probability, Conic Sections (Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola), Three-Dimensional Geometry, Applications of Derivatives, Integral Calculus, Differential Equations, Vectors
blueprints.label: Skew Lines and Volume Optimization

blueprint.pattern: Find the shortest distance between two skew lines defined by vector equations, then use this distance as the height of a parallelepiped to find the volume given a constraint on the base vectors.
blueprint.required: Must involve the scalar triple product and the projection of the common perpendicular vector.
blueprint.banned: Simple calculation of shortest distance between two lines given in Cartesian form.
blueprint.stemHint: Lines L1: r = a + t(b) and L2: r = c + s(d). If the shortest distance is h, find the volume of the parallelepiped formed by vectors b, d, and (a-c).
